C0895.title: Beware: Credential Stuffing Is Stealing Your Accounts
C0895.summary: In November 2016, security experts warned that user accounts on small and medium-sized websites are vulnerable to credential stuffing attacks. Attackers use automated tools to test stolen credentials at scale, bypassing traditional CAPTCHA defenses. Stronger technical measures are needed to raise the cost for attackers.
